verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Firecrawl scrapes pages with an actual browser session ('Browser Sandbox... managed browser sessions for interactive workflows', 'click, fill forms, extract dynamic content'), and community evidence confirms it uses a real headless browser (Puppeteer) to render pages rather than static HTTP fetch, which supports JS-heavy SPA rendering. Output can be returned as HTML per docs-1. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/proof of correctly rendering complex SPAs, and community notes it uses Puppeteer not Playwright with some limitations in certain modes.
